feasibility.successPath: Feasible using existing R217/R239 saved-combat replay in a fresh isolated R169 save, DEBUG + STANDARD_PLAY_R169 Simulator build; it emits a unique R239 sidecar without dispatching rewards. The validator checks execute_started -> hit_visual_deferred -> execute_completed -> hit_visual_started_after_execute -> hit_visual_completed, joined by actor/root/generation/event sequence.
feasibility.lethalCancelPath: Conditionally feasible only if a deterministic saved replay produces a lethal_resolve while that same controller has a pending deferred hit; validator requires the exact cancellation reason and rejects later deferred-hit start. No such fixture is pinned here.
feasibility.resetPath: Not observable from the current single saved-replay lifecycle sidecar: the R239 observer captures one execute group and is detached after playback; controller reset/stop is not exported as a distinct replay receipt. Needs a narrow test seam or app-controller test target.
feasibility.invalidClipFallback: Not feasible with the existing fixed catalog unless a real execute clip is non-looping but has missing/invalid duration. A synthetic malformed clip requires explicit test-only art injection or a controller seam; no arbitrary asset mutation is proposed.

boundedRunContract.oneDebugSimulatorBuild: Compile one R418 R004 source map with existing R239 observer; no device signing or installation to the normal bundle.
boundedRunContract.fixture: R411 R005 B_R05_B SaveEnvelope/report copied into a fresh isolated QA namespace; technical fixture, not ordinary progression.
boundedRunContract.gameSaveWrites: Only fresh isolated QA save allowed; replay must produce zero gameplay dispatch/reward and exact saved-combat identity before/after.
boundedRunContract.limits: One successful lifecycle capture; optional second only for an independently pinned lethal-cancel replay. Unknown/unobserved conditions report NOT_OBSERVED, never PASS by absence.
notIncluded: Malformed-clip fallback without a valid pinned asset/test seam
